test_title: PYST 38 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A sum of money doubles in 10 years at simple interest. What is the rate of interest per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Sum doubles in 10 years

⇒ Amount = 2P

Time = 10 years

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × r × t) ÷ 100

Amount = P + SI

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = 2P − P = P

⇒ P = (P × r × 10) ÷ 100

⇒ 1 = (r × 10) ÷ 100

⇒ 100 = 10r

⇒ r = 10%

**∴ Rate = 10% per annum**
